title: projects.yml
description: The set of repos this installation supervises, plus the optional Decision Inbox host. The governance_repo is the canonical doctrine + default Decision Inbox host. Supervised repos are the ones whose PRs the bot gates.

governance_repo.description: Owner/name of the governance repository. Holds canonical doctrine + receives Decision Inbox issues (unless decision_inbox.repository overrides).

supervised_repos.description: Owner/name of each repository whose PRs the bot gates (L1-L4). The governance_repo itself MAY be listed here if you want its PRs gated too.

bot_repo.description: Owner/name of the bot's own repository, if separate from governance_repo. The classifier votes Quadrant D on PRs to this repo. If absent, defaults to governance_repo.

decision_inbox.description: Optional. Override the Decision Inbox host and configure the default-off lifecycle. If absent, repository defaults to governance_repo and no timer actions run.

repository.description: Owner/name of the repository where Decision Inbox issues are opened. Defaults to governance_repo. Use when you want a separate inbox repo for many supervised repos to share.

thresholds.description: Deprecated compatibility-only keys. The loader accepts but ignores every value in this object; these keys do not schedule reminders, abandonment, or auto-close.

nudge_days.description: Deprecated and ignored. Use decision_inbox.lifecycle.reminder_hours in a deliberately enabled lifecycle.

abandon_days.description: Deprecated and ignored. No abandonment state is implemented.

auto_close_days.description: Deprecated and ignored. Pending-owner issues are never closed by the lifecycle.

lifecycle.description: Optional reminder/escalation lifecycle. Default OFF: enabled must be true before the bot reads availability or posts lifecycle comments. It never approves, rejects, labels abandoned, or closes an issue.

enabled.description: Explicit activation switch. False or absent means zero lifecycle API activity and preserves the asynchronous no-timer behavior.

reminder_hours.description: Effective open hours before the one-time reminder marker comment. Outing-window overlap is excluded.

escalate_hours.description: Effective open hours before the one-time escalation marker comment. Must be greater than reminder_hours (also checked by the loader).

availability.description: Optional generic repository-file source. When configured, the governance installation reads this file and matches the configured line_prefix followed by either 'available', 'quiet', or '<start> - <end> outing'.

repository.description: Owner/name of the readable repository that holds the availability file.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the UTF-8 availability file. Absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.

ref.description: Git ref to read. Defaults to main.

line_prefix.description: Literal prefix that identifies availability contract lines. The parser escapes it; it is not a regular expression.

break_glass.description: Optional. Tune the break-glass auditor's ADR deadline. Default: ADR required within 24 hours of any [break-glass-*] commit on main.

adr_deadline_hours.description: Hours after a break-glass commit during which an ADR referencing the commit SHA must land in docs/decisions/. Past this window the L5 auditor surfaces an 'unaudited' Issue.

audit_only_repos.description: Optional (DEC-C). Repos that are AUDITED on main (L2 post-merge re-validation + L5 break-glass + the unauthorized-push detector) but whose open PRs are NOT gated (L1-L4 skipped). Use for the governance repo so it can be supervised without the self-gating paradox. Each entry should also appear in supervised_repos. Default [] = every supervised repo is fully gated (v1.0.0 behavior).

repo_overrides.description: Optional (R1). Per-repo configuration overrides keyed by 'owner/name'. A key present here overrides the corresponding global default for that repo only.

required_checks.description: Named CI check-runs that MUST each be present + green on a PR head for C2 (and L2) to pass in THIS repo. Overrides the global env.yml required_checks. An explicit empty list [] forces 'no named checks' for this repo (back to the all-completed-checks-succeed behavior) even when a global default is set.

expected_check_publisher.description: The GitHub App slug that must have published a green check-run for it to count toward C2 in THIS repo. Overrides the global env.yml expected_check_publisher. A same-named (or, on the no-named-required path, any) green run from a different App is treated as 'not yet green' (fail closed).
